# shoal_namespace (Data Source)

Look up an existing namespace (`GET /v1/namespaces/{name}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "shoal_namespace" "shared" {
  name = "shared"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
